problem_type: Recurrence metrics relied solely on coarse file-overlap heuristics without an explicit contract declaration field, producing ~42% false positives and mixing structural refactors with bug recurrences
symptom: scripts/eng-metrics.mjs reported 31% due recurrence (52/167) on 2026-11-22, of which manual audit showed 22/52 (42.3%) were coincidental file overlaps or structural refactors rather than true recurrences.
direct_cause: Schema v3 root-cause contracts had no recurrence_of field, and eng-metrics.mjs judged recurrence purely by >=2 shared non-hub scope_paths covering >=50% of the smaller set.
class_root: Measuring defect recurrence by file-set overlap instead of explicit author-declared predecessor identity (with a validated fail-closed reference boundary and a strictly separated low-false-positive fallback for historical contracts).
affected_population: All engineering metric reports generated by scripts/eng-metrics.mjs and SessionStart eng-metrics-line.sh
All schema v3 root-cause contracts validated by scripts/root-cause-contracts.mjs
internal_only_reason: Root-cause contract schema v3 and internal engineering recurrence metrics are Nomi repository governance conventions.
invariants: Any non-null recurrence_of reference in a v3 contract must be a valid slug or filename under docs/fixes/, must not self-reference or duplicate, and must exist in docs/fixes/ (fail-closed).
eng-metrics.mjs always reports declared recurrence counts and legacy fallback estimates as two strictly separated numbers and never merges them into one.

door_reduction.why_not: Validation lives in root-cause-contracts.mjs (merge gate) and metric aggregation lives in eng-metrics.mjs (reporting); both share resolveRecurrenceRef as the single reference normalization owner.

generality_proof: Centralizing recurrence_of reference normalization in resolveRecurrenceRef and enforcing fail-closed existence/self-reference checks in validateRecurrenceOf (classified as blocking in classifyFindings) ensures no typo or dangling reference can enter docs/fixes/, while eng-metrics.mjs reads the same normalized slug and strictly separates declared vs legacy fallback cohorts.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Single normalization and format-validation owner for recurrence_of contract references.
Separates declared recurrence_of metrics from Simple S-sym legacy fallback estimates.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Validates recurrence_of on every changed schema v3 contract and classifies all recurrence_of errors as blocking.
Uses resolveRecurrenceRef for declared recurrence_of, applies Simple S-sym only to undeclared legacy contracts, excludes structural contracts, and reports both numbers separately.

recurrence.reason: Any new contract or metric reader that parses recurrence_of or computes recurrence without sharing resolveRecurrenceRef and declared/estimated separation would reintroduce silent typos or conflated rates.

prevention.invariant: Non-null recurrence_of references fail closed unless they resolve to an existing non-self contract in docs/fixes/.
prevention.failure_mode: check-root-cause-contracts exits non-zero with a blocking schema error naming the invalid or missing target.
prevention.strategy: Enforce recurrence_of schema and existence checks in validateRecurrenceOf and keep /recurrence_of/ in BLOCKING_PATTERNS.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replaced the old single-number scope_paths >=2 & >=50% overlap heuristic in scripts/eng-metrics.mjs with declared-first recurrence_of plus Simple S-sym legacy fallback in the same commit.

migration: Existing contracts without recurrence_of remain valid and are automatically routed to the legacy fallback estimate cohort; new contracts can set recurrence_of to null or prior contract slug(s).
residual_risks: Historical contracts without recurrence_of still rely on the Simple S-sym fallback estimate (87.5% precision / 58.3% recall on the 30-pair independent holdout set) until declared contracts accumulate.
